auto_click.name: Auto-click
auto_click.description: Enable the cube hazard scanner and experimental jump timing.

auto_jump.name: Experimental cube auto-jump
auto_jump.description: Queues one jump for each detected hazard when the cube is grounded. Timing is experimental; disabled by default.

jump_anticipation_frames.name: Jump anticipation
jump_anticipation_frames.description: Base lead time before a detected hazard (20–60 physics frames). Higher values jump earlier.

correction_frames.name: Correction window
correction_frames.description: Adds 2–10 extra physics frames to the jump anticipation as a timing margin.
